name: page-flip
title: Page Flip
description: Turn a double-sided page around its spine.
useCases: In a digital booklet, a visitor flips through short chapter captions like pages in a printed edition.
In a visual concept presentation, a designer shows one idea per spread and moves in either direction with the arrow keys.
task: Turn a double-sided page around its spine.
behavior: Pass page text in reading order. Navigation and the current position are managed internally.
